aula.objetivo: Name your family members, use «mio», «tuo» and «suo» with the right gender and article, and describe who people are and what they do. Avoid the English-speaker traps: an article before a job, a missing article before a possessive, and «parenti» for «parents».

blocos.titulo: Family words: gender pairs and a false friend
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: many family words come in masculine and feminine pairs that differ only in the ending: «il fratello» / «la sorella», «il nonno» / «la nonna», «lo zio» / «la zia», «il cugino» / «la cugina». STEP 2: the plural of a mixed pair is masculine: «i nonni» are grandparents (grandfather and grandmother, or both grandfathers), «i fratelli» are brothers or brother and sister. STEP 3: «i genitori» means «the parents». It does not mean «relatives»: for that, Italian uses «i parenti». English speakers mix the two because «parents» and «parenti» look alike. STEP 4: «la mamma» and «il papà» are the everyday words for mum and dad. «Il padre» and «la madre» are the formal or neutral ones: «mio padre è medico». STEP 5: stress: «il papà» has a written accent on the last vowel: «pah-PAH». «Mamma» has two «m» in the middle, so hold the sound a little longer: «MAHM-mah». STEP 6: «nonno» and «nonna» keep the double «n» in the middle: «NOHN-noh», «NOHN-nah». Do not read them as «nono», because that would be a different word: «nono» is «ninth». STEP 7: «famiglia» sounds «fah-MEE-lyah»: the «gli» is the same sound as «lli» in «million».
blocos.comparacao: English has «grandparents», «siblings» and «parents» as ready-made group words; Italian builds the same ideas from the masculine plural («i nonni», «i fratelli») or uses «i genitori». The plural of a mixed group is masculine, which has no English counterpart. And the false friend is a real trap: «i parenti» are all your relatives (aunts, cousins and so on), not your parents.

erros.errado: I miei parenti sono Paolo e Anna.
erros.certo: I miei genitori sono Paolo e Anna.
erros.motivo: «Parenti» means relatives. Your parents are «i genitori».
«Nono» (ninth) is a different word: keep the double «n».
A group of grandfather and grandmother takes the masculine plural.

itens.enunciado: What is the plural for a brother and a sister?
itens.explicacao: A mixed group takes the masculine plural.

itens.enunciado: Il ___ è il padre di mio padre. (grandfather)
